question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become supported public Plugin SDK exports for cross-plugin progress intent?
rationale: The runtime repair is mechanical, but making these symbols part of the third-party SDK is a lasting compatibility decision that repository policy reserves for explicit maintainer direction.

options.title: Approve the generic contract
options.body: Keep the narrow generic exports, add any required SDK documentation or contract coverage, and merge after the native-block defects are fixed.

options.title: Keep the contract internal
options.body: Redesign the cross-plugin handoff so bundled Codex and Slack can share typed intent without adding permanent public exports.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow generic exports, add any required SDK documentation or contract coverage, and merge after the native-block defects are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows ownership of the native Slack block path, and this choice couples that behavior to the public Plugin SDK boundary.
